data_fields.name: objective_required
data_fields.donor_constant: required flag per objective (default true for Add from Lua)

data_fields.name: anchor_count_drop
data_fields.donor_constant: 3 anchors, each death calls the drop

best_idea: One trait owns objective state; transitions are one-way and idempotent, a win needs every required objective completed, and scripts only call that writer, so a per-tick check or a one-shot world event cannot double-count.
decision_why: Keep the one writer, the one-way idempotent states and the required gate, which fit the one-ledger ruling. Replace the per-tick scan of MustBeDestroyed actors with event-driven checks, and make completed and failed terminal, since the donor lets a completed objective be marked failed.
acceptance: A server test asserts that completing an objective twice gives one win and one event, that a failed required objective ends that player's run, and that a completed objective cannot later become failed; in the client the quest log shows the objective once as Completed.
